qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominant Swiss telecom infrastructure generates steady domestic cash flow, but Swiss revenue is stagnant/deflationary and the debt-funded €8B acquisition of Vodafone Italia dilutes ROIC to ~10.9% with sub-8% incremental ROIIC in a competitive Italian telecom market.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (gate_3b_pricing_and_proof = 'N', REJECT). Core Swiss telecom revenue has been stagnant-to-deflationary for years, and the €8B debt-financed acquisition of Vodafone Italia dilutes ROIC to ~10.9% with incremental ROIIC well below the 12% hurdle in a brutally competitive Italian market.
qualitative.evidence: Swisscom maintains dominant market shares in Switzerland with 13% median historical ROIC. However, domestic revenue grew 0% over 2022-2024. The 100% debt-funded acquisition of Vodafone Italia (€8B) increases net debt-to-EBITDA to ~2.7x and generates sub-8% incremental ROIIC, diluting 2025 GAAP ROIC to 10.94% and failing Gate 3b proof of moat.
